program.name: Quick Balance
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Balanced and short with no gear: bodyweight strength, a Tabata or bouts, then a flow or core.
program.about: The shortest way to train everything. Bodyweight strength first, then a Tabata one day or two shadowboxing bouts the next, then a short flow or a core circuit. No equipment needed. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Bodyweight, Tabata & flow / bodyweight, bouts & core, short
